title: Ming Foundation Authority Manifest
purpose: Machine-readable proposal for the three-class authority model and Foundation-to-MingOS adoption bridge. It is consumable evidence, not a conformance, certification, or self-executing acceptance claim.

canonical_bridge.foundation: defines what must never be violated
canonical_bridge.mingos: defines how authority, evidence, memory, context and correction travel across spaces
canonical_bridge.products: decide how to help within those boundaries

forbidden_upgrade: a product field -> a MingOS object -> a Foundation rule without independent cross-space evidence and an explicit governance decision

authority_items.trigger_evidence: current evidence of credible life-safety, serious violence, abuse, or serious-harm risk
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: activate proportionate minimum-necessary protective handling and Safety-owned action
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: ordinary distress, a legacy category, or model confidence alone must not activate this guard
authority_items.test_expectation: Safety tests must preserve source/provenance, mixed-source cases, and false-positive/false-negative boundaries

authority_items.trigger_evidence: any collection, use, disclosure, inference, action, or retention involving a person or third party
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: require scoped consent/authorization, minimization, privacy protection, and non-coercive handling appropriate to the operation
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: product convenience, engagement, family membership, or prior participation must not imply unlimited consent
authority_items.test_expectation: verify authorization scope, minimization, refusal/exit paths, and third-party handling where applicable

authority_items.trigger_evidence: any stored or used interpretation, memory, profile, decision, or action that can materially affect a person
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: preserve inspect/correct/reject/revise/revoke or equivalent meaningful contestability and traceable supersession
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: a prior system interpretation must not become irreversible identity or unchallengeable truth
authority_items.test_expectation: verify correction propagation, stale-context invalidation, revision history, and refusal/revocation where feasible

authority_items.trigger_evidence: any claim, inference, memory, recommendation, safety transition, or authority decision
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: preserve source, knowledge status, uncertainty, and provenance at the level materially required for review
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: REPORT/INTERPRETATION/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN must not be silently upgraded to FACT or certainty
authority_items.test_expectation: verify knowledge-status separation, provenance retention, uncertainty preservation, and no fabricated certainty

authority_items.trigger_evidence: any system output that could determine identity, meaning, life direction, professional judgment, or consequential choice
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: support understanding and bounded options while preserving accountable human authority
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: AI/model/system output must not silently become final authority over identity, conscience, diagnosis, or life direction
authority_items.test_expectation: verify explicit uncertainty/limits and that consequential human or professional decisions remain contestable and accountable

authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: use the output as hypothesis, organization, or evidence candidate only within its declared authority
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: category/confidence alone must not prescribe, prohibit, refer, write identity memory, or activate a protective guard
authority_items.test_expectation: inspect the actual consumer chain and verify independent evidence ownership for any consequential effect

authority_items.trigger_evidence: ordinary interaction without a higher-priority hard-invariant trigger
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: organize evidence and understanding before proposing advice or action
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not become a mandatory response template or fixed wording
authority_items.test_expectation: MingOS-side scenarios should cover insufficient information, clarification, and product-owned response variation

authority_items.trigger_evidence: interaction contains facts, reports, feelings, interpretations, inferences, unknowns, or corrections
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: carry distinct knowledge-status semantics across context, memory, and handoff
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not force a product-specific ledger schema, UI, or module name

authority_items.trigger_evidence: new evidence, correction, changed circumstances, or a later real-life return conflicts with prior understanding
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: retire, supersede, or reduce reliance on older interpretations while retaining traceability
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not require a universal product memory implementation
authority_items.test_expectation: MingOS-side scenarios should cover correction, changed reality, supersession, and continuity

authority_items.trigger_evidence: ordinary interaction where no independent authority requires action
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: allow a valid outcome of continuing, clarifying, reflecting, pausing, or doing nothing yet
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not be converted into an opposite universal rule that action is forbidden; products may offer optional action when warranted
authority_items.test_expectation: MingOS-side scenarios must include ordinary no-action and explicit-help-request cases

authority_items.trigger_evidence: the person asks for help/action, explicitly chooses a direction, or the product has current evidence supporting an optional candidate
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: offer a rejectable product-owned action candidate
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: an internally optional candidate must not become a mandatory user-visible command or durable action memory without explicit choice
authority_items.test_expectation: MingOS-side scenarios must verify rejectability, explicit choice, and the independent Safety exception

authority_items.trigger_evidence: current evidence and expressed intent are available
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: allow response depth, clarification, explanation, or support dose to adapt to the current interaction
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: historical stage/layer/category must not silently own pacing or response mode
authority_items.test_expectation: MingOS-side scenarios should vary intent and evidence without requiring a universal product script

authority_items.trigger_evidence: product context and current user/product evidence
authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: choose wording, tone, length, ask/reflect/explain/pause/action rhythm, navigation, and presentation
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: a successful product pattern must not become a MingOS or Foundation requirement merely because it works locally
authority_items.test_expectation: product validates its own user value while preserving inherited hard boundaries and adopted runtime semantics

authority_items.permitted_downstream_effect: choose model/provider, prompt, agent, router, orchestration, profile, read-model, and rollout topology
authority_items.forbidden_authority_upgrade: module names, fields, environment flags, and implementation topology must not be promoted upstream without independent cross-space evidence
authority_items.test_expectation: product tests implementation behavior; upstream tests only the reusable semantic boundary

semantic_compatibility_contract.rule: Upstream work is triggered by semantic-boundary change and evidence, not ordinary implementation churn.

current_state_reference.purpose: Current stage, version, pilot authorization, and execution state live in the canonical-state record; this manifest does not duplicate them as policy constants.

non_claims: current product implementation is already a generic MingOS or Foundation standard
ADR-0029 is Accepted before an explicit review/decision

evidence_gate.real_family_evidence: unknown at Foundation level beyond the product fact source
